description: Performance audits of public school districts in Northampton County
auditor: Pennsylvania Department of the Auditor General

audits.title: Easton Area School District

findingDetails.title: Transportation Documentation Issues
findingDetails.description: Failed to obtain and keep supporting documentation for multiple components of transportation reimbursements from the state

findingDetails.title: Foster Student Verification
findingDetails.description: Lacked required documentation to verify nonresident foster student reimbursements
findingDetails.districtResponse: Will require annual placement letters for accurate classification and reporting. Obtained all placement letters for 2019-2020 and 2020-2021.

findingDetails.title: Safety Drill Compliance
findingDetails.description: Failed to conduct all required monthly fire drills and security drills
findingDetails.regulation: State fire safety and security drill requirements

audits.description: Multiple findings related to documentation and safety compliance

audits.title: Bethlehem Area School District

findingDetails.title: Internal Control Deficiency
findingDetails.description: Segregation of duties issue in accounts payable
findingDetails.recommendation: Implement dual approval for payments over threshold

audits.description: Generally compliant with minor internal control finding

audits.title: Nazareth Area School District
audits.description: Full compliance with all audit areas
